ct-municipal-officeholders.summary: The Town card names the town you picked, and not its first selectman, mayor or council.
ct-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Connecticut's towns has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
ct-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each town's first selectman, mayor or council, or a town's own published list of them.

ct-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its board of education.
ct-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Connecticut's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
ct-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

ct-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the nation whose land you clicked on, with its seat and website where they are known. It does not name any nation's council yet.
ct-tribal-government.why: This app has not read any Connecticut tribe's council list yet. Each tribe publishes its own, which has to be read one tribe at a time.
ct-tribal-government.wanted: Each tribe's own published list of its council, read one tribe at a time.
